method: From Kalshi legs priced 30–85¢ with edge ≥ about −2.5 and no flags (one per game), a leg was kept only when at least two of these agreed and none disagreed: Polymarket's top sports traders on its side, a published expert pick or model read today, and concrete news/matchup reasoning. The dump's expert matching came back empty again, so experts were matched by hand against picks/latest.json. Dropped as conflicts: Rangers/Canucks (seven outlets on New York, top traders about $6.7k on Vancouver), Grizzlies/Pelicans (three outlets on Memphis, top traders $8k on the Pelicans moneyline), Clippers (three outlets on LA, $33k of top-trader money on OKC), Cavaliers/Heat and Knicks/Pacers (outlets split), Bulls +7.5 (top traders, but Covers and Predictem on Atlanta), Houston/Colorado, FSU/Pitt, Ole Miss/Oklahoma, Washington/Michigan State, Texas/LSU, Wake Forest/SMU, Michigan/Oregon, Louisville/UNC, and Harrison/Nunes, Borralho/Belgaroui and Gane/Hokit at UFC 334 (experts one way, top traders the other or split). Auburn (NCAAB) carried a line-move flag. No free picks were published yet for Saturday's NBA or NHL games, so Saturday is covered by college football and UFC. Donte Johnson is priced about −3.1, past the usual limit, and was kept as the last leg because top traders and VSiN agree.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than fair, so expected return is slightly negative and gets worse with every leg added.

ladder.label: Indiana Hoosiers −7.5
ladder.why: Top Polymarket traders have about $5.3k on Indiana −7.5 against $1.0k, and two outlets lay the points: Covers' Rob Paul (Indiana's top-10 havoc defense vs a poor USC defense) and VSiN's Steve Makinen (Indiana −10; notes the line moved from −7.5 to −10 and USC struggles on East Coast trips). Kalshi still offers the opening number.

ladder.label: Over 55.5
ladder.why: Top traders have about $7.8k on the Over against under $100. Covers' Chris Vasile picks Over 57.5, saying both offenses score heavily and both defenses are leaky; Kalshi's 55.5 is two points lower than his number.

ladder.label: Atlanta Hawks
ladder.why: Top traders have about $3.5k on Atlanta against $1.5k. Covers' Jon Metler picks the Hawks moneyline (switchable defenders disrupt Giddey; Chicago is without Caleb Wilson), and Predictem's Joe Jensen takes Atlanta −7.5, noting the Bulls rank last in net and defensive rating; Dimers' model projects 124-119 Hawks.

ladder.label: Under 6.5
ladder.why: Two outlets have the Under 6.5 and none the Over at that number: Pickswise's Jon Yaremko makes it his 5-star best bet (both teams allow about 2.6 goals per game; under 4-1 in Vegas's last five at this total), and Bleacher Nation's Data Skrive model projects 6 goals. No top-trader money either way.

ladder.label: South Carolina Gamecocks −6.5
ladder.why: Top traders have about $600 on South Carolina and nothing against. VSiN's Steve Makinen (4-game ATS surge; Arkansas has one SEC win) and Athlon's Steven Lassan both lay −7.5, a point more than this leg. Caution: Lassan's pick depends on QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle, questionable) being close to full go.

sources.name: Athlon via Yahoo / Steven Lassan (South Carolina −7.5)

ladder.label: Alabama Crimson Tide −10.5
ladder.why: Covers' Chris Hatfield (Alabama −16.5: far better adjusted efficiency; Vandy's defense allows success on about 46% of snaps; QB Keelon Russell probable) and Athlon's Kyle Wood (Alabama −17.5) both expect a big Alabama win; this leg only needs 11+. Only about $130 of top-trader money sits on Vanderbilt +17.5.

ladder.label: Ohio State Buckeyes
ladder.why: A short favourite to fill the ladder: Covers' Rob Paul (−11.5) and VSiN's Steve Makinen (−12.5) both lay double digits with Ohio State, and Northwestern is without QB Aidan Chiles. Top-trader money is small but all on Ohio State.

ladder.label: Donte Johnson
ladder.why: Top traders have about $4.1k on Johnson against $160, and VSiN's Lou Finocchiaro makes him his best bet: Johnson's pressure should break Almeida, who has 44% striking defence and was knocked out last time. Almeida is a late replacement for Baisangur Susurkaev. Priced about 3 points over fair, past the usual limit, so it's the last leg.
